sahneler.metin: A wingless NASA test aircraft slammed into a dry lake bed on landing.
Suddenly it tumbled over and over across the desert floor.
It was a lifting body, using its shape to fly.
Near the ground, it began rolling side to side.
Then a helicopter seemed to threaten a collision.
He drifted to an unmarked area where height was hard to judge.
The craft was rebuilt with a centre fin.

aciklama:
M2-F2 tumbled across the lake bed on landing. The cause: a hard-to-control wingless body, a distraction, and poor height cues on an unmarked surface.
